label: MYB::NFIB

sections.text: MYB encodes a transcription factor involved in progenitor-cell proliferation and differentiation.
NFIB encodes a nuclear-factor-I transcription factor involved in tissue development.

The rearrangement alters MYB-family regulatory architecture and drives abnormal MYB-family transcription. MYB::NFIB is a recurrent fusion in adenoid cystic carcinoma; MYB- and MYBL1-driven tumors form related molecular groups.
